steps.name: scripts load through versioned URLs, so an update never mixes new and cached modules
steps.js: (() => { const js = performance.getEntriesByType('resource').map(e => new URL(e.name)).filter(u => u.pathname.startsWith('/assets/js/')); return [js.length > 5, js.every(u => /^\?v=[0-9a-f]{10}$/.test(u.search)), js.some(u => u.pathname === '/assets/js/engine/shaders.js')]; })()
